mapper.select:
/* 양수 게시글 등록 시 상품 선택 */ SELECT p.product_category_no , p.item_no, p.products_no, p.products_nm FROM products p
p.product_category_no = #{productCategoryNum}

/* 양수 게시글 등록 시 카테고리 선택 */ SELECT i.product_category_no , i.item_no, i.item_nm FROM item i
i.product_category_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mdCategoryNo}, '%')

/* 내 양수 게시글 목록 조회 */ SELECT ab.assignee_no, ab.cust_id, c.cust_nm , ab.product_category_no, pc.middle_category , pc.small_category , ab.products_nm, ab.rental_fee, ab.remaining_months, ab.desired_install_area, ab.quantity, ab.assignee_content, ab.board_valid_date, ab.register_date, ab.revision_date FROM customer c RIGHT JOIN assignee_board ab USING (cust_id) INNER JOIN products_category pc USING (product_category_no) WHERE ab.cust_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY ab.register_date DESC;

/* 양수 게시글 정보 조회 */ SELECT ab.assignee_no, ab.cust_id, c.cust_nm , ab.product_category_no, pc.middle_category , pc.small_category , p.products_no , ab.products_nm, ab.rental_fee, ab.remaining_months, ab.desired_install_area, ab.quantity, ab.assignee_content, ab.board_valid_date, ab.register_date, ab.revision_date FROM customer c RIGHT JOIN assignee_board ab USING (cust_id) INNER JOIN products_category pc USING (product_category_no) INNER JOIN products p ON pc.product_category_no = p.product_category_no WHERE ab.assignee_no = #{assigneeBoardNum};

/* 양수 게시글 전체 행 수 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(assignee_no) FROM customer c RIGHT JOIN assignee_board ab USING (cust_id) INNER JOIN products_category pc USING (product_category_no)
ab.products_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
